description: Production profile chosen from the benchmarks in model/README.md: Gemma 4 12B QAT (Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL), vision, MTP speculative decoding, a 320k 4-bit KV cache split into 3 slots: three conversations at once, each up to 109k tokens, each at the speed of its own length. ~11.1 GB VRAM, ~1.6-2.0 GB RAM, bounded.
